pd258.title: [pdt] Approve Estima Grant
pd258.description:
Only first Milestone setup due to USDC.inj migration.

This proposal seeks funding to build a native onchain prediction-market protocol for Terra. The flagship product will be a market for expected bankruptcy or wind-down claim recovery: users can express what percentage of an allowed claim they believe will ultimately be paid, trade that expectation before final resolution, and exit positions through a combination of automated liquidity and resting orders.
The protocol is deliberately designed as general infrastructure rather than a single-purpose application. Its core primitive is a bounded scalar market with an outcome between 0 and 1. A recovery market may resolve to 0.47 (47% recovery); a conventional YES/NO market is simply the same primitive resolving to 0 or 1. This enables future markets covering governance outcomes, protocol events, litigation, launches, economic metrics, and other objectively resolvable questions without building separate trading infrastructure.

A separate production DEX interface will expose the generalized liquidity engine directly. This makes the reusable CLMM + CLOB infrastructure a visible grant deliverable rather than contract-level groundwork that is only indirectly demonstrated through the prediction-market UI.

1. Project Kickoff & Core Development
Project start and implementation of the core protocol stack: market contracts, 0-1 scalar primitive, CLOB, concentrated-liquidity engine, router, collateral/resolution framework, fee accounting, testing infrastructure, and application integration.
$45,000

2. Indexer & Advanced Analytics
Production indexer/API and advanced analytics interface including historical trades/candles, AMM and CLOB depth, market depth and price impact, volume, fees, routing statistics, LP analytics, and historical market data. Completion requires a working deployment integrated with the protocol.
$15,000

3. DEX Frontend & Generalized Analytics
Production DEX interface integrated with the generalized CLMM + CLOB engine, including pool discovery, swap/quote UX, routing visibility, concentrated-liquidity management, and pool analytics for price, TVL, volume, fees, depth, liquidity distribution, and recent trades. The interface must demonstrate the reusable market infrastructure independently of the prediction-market frontend.
$15,000

4. Mainnet Launch
Final protocol and frontend integration, testnet hardening, production readiness, deployment, and launch of the flagship market on Terra mainnet. Milestone completion requires a successful mainnet launch.
$75,000
